note: Re-judged 2026-11-06 by an independent auditor who authored none of the changes; no test or record ran for this judgement, statements about what reddens are by reading unless called observed. RFC 4271 Section 5.1.2: "When a given BGP speaker advertises the route to an internal peer, the advertising speaker SHALL NOT modify the AS_PATH attribute associated with the route." The stale rail gap an earlier auditor named is closed: TestRFC4271StaleReadvertiseASPathEditsSkipInternalPeers drives decideStaleReadvertise on the opted-filter and whole-chain runs, requires the filter was asked, staleKeep and the body byte for byte toward an internal and an RFC 7705 migration-internal destination, and staleModify with the exact edited path toward the same peer AS with no migration AS. Its recorded mutant (stale_readvertise_chain.go:159, asPathEditable true) was observed red in all four subtests (scratch rec-new.log). Its bound: the unit builds dest itself, so dropping IsIBGP: peer.IsIBGP() in sendStaleReadvertiseUnit reddens no tagged unit. WEAK on question 4, one rail still short of the whole requirement: the route-server rail. reactorForwardRSSection hands the export chain !facts.isEBGP (forward_rs.go:473, then libraryASPathOps) and gates as-override and the prepend on facts.isEBGP (forward_rs.go:577). Internal destinations reach this rail: its selection holds no internal or RS-client test, and TestRFC4271ForwardAddsLocalPrefTowardInternalPeer delivers to one with rs true. Every forward unit tagged here passes rs false (TestRFC4271ForwardASPathUnmodifiedTowardInternalPeer, TestRFC4271ForwardExportASPathEditsSkipInternalPeers), and the others call the chain, the writers or the dry run directly, so changing either guard reddens no tagged unit. The code is guarded today, so this is a missing proof, not a defect. What holds: both forward units assert exact bytes with an external control in one fan-out; TestRFC4271ExportPrependNeverModifiesAnInternalPeersASPath and TestRFC4271PolicyDryRunAgreesNoASPathEditTowardAnInternalPeer are exact with controls; TestRFC4271ExportASPathEditsFollowTheMigrationAwareInternalVerdict changed in its doc comment only and the new claim is accurate. Records on the other units are whole-body panics, proving reach only, and the batch and rfc4271_test.go tags carry none. The rfc4271_test.go citations are true: reactor_wire.go:513-522 is the AS_PATH switch through writeASPathAttr in writeAnnounceUpdate. Those two units build a route with no path, so they assert the origination sentence of Section 5.1.2 ("the originating speaker includes an empty AS_PATH attribute in all UPDATE messages sent to internal peers"), not non-modification of a propagated path: correct assertions, misattributed. To reach enforced: tag a unit on reactorForwardRS, as-override and as-path-prepend and remove-private toward internal and migration-internal destinations with an external control, exact AS_PATH asserted, and record a mutant on each of forward_rs.go:473 and :577.
